base_member_text: [L41] (LOW/permissions) The generated module file is made mode 777, granting unnecessary write/execute permissions to all users.
audit_member_text: [L41] (HIGH/shared-file-permissions) The installed environment module is made world-writable with chmod 777.

base_member_text: [L22-L35] (MED/error-handling/reproducibility) The build, install, archive, and directory transitions have no failure checks or `set -e`, allowing a failed build or missing install directory to proceed to artifact publication.
audit_member_text: [L12-L41] (HIGH/build-failure-propagation) Unchecked directory changes, module loads and build commands allow packaging and module publication to proceed after failure and mask the failed build.

adversarial.rationale: The full H6 script has no status checks between its directory changes, dependency loads, autogen/configure/make/install, tar, module generation and final chmod (trunk/config/example_install_new_version_H6.sh:12-41). Sourcing /etc/profile could supply external errexit policy, but no repository caller or supplied profile guarantees it, and a child autogen failure cannot terminate an ordinary parent Bash; successful later publication/chmod can therefore mask an earlier failure.

base_member_text: [L9-L12,L33,L37] (LOW/quoting/path-contract) Directory and environment-variable expansions are unquoted in `cd` and path construction, so a checkout path containing whitespace is not supported.
audit_member_text: [L33-L39] (LOW/path-quoting) Workspace and project paths use partially unquoted expansions, so whitespace in the checkout path breaks packaging or module generation.
[L26-L35] (MED/artifact-layout) Installation targets /opt/xbeach but archiving reads a workspace install directory that this script neither creates nor populates.
[L28] (MED/scientific-compiler-semantics) Unconditional -ffast-math permits assumptions and arithmetic transformations that can invalidate NaN diagnostics and alter scientific results.
